name: Covidence Datasource Import
description: Import Covidence screening packages as datasource-backed projects with reused prompts and seeded human judgments for title/abstract and full-text workflows.

userStories.title: Add Covidence package config and asset storage helpers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want Covidence imports to persist their package files and cursor config so datasource create and reimport can use a stable package definition.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Covidence package config helpers that store mode, file roles, and saved asset paths in `data_source.cursor`.
Save uploaded package files under `assets/covidence_imports/<datasourceId>/` with path validation suitable for reimport.
The helpers support both `title_abstract` and `full_text` modes without inventing a second persistence format.

userStories.title: Parse Covidence CSV exports into labeled reference rows
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want CSV Covidence exports parsed into a consistent reference shape so later merge and import steps can treat file roles uniformly.
acceptanceCriteria: Parse Covidence reference CSV files into rows that preserve citation metadata plus tags, notes, and exclusion reasons when present.
Support labeled file roles for `all`, `irrelevant`, `full_text`, `excluded`, and `included` without losing the source-role information.
Return stable parse errors for malformed or unsupported CSV inputs instead of silently dropping rows.

userStories.title: Parse Covidence RIS exports into labeled reference rows
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want RIS Covidence exports parsed into the same reference shape as CSV so either export format can drive the screening import flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Parse Covidence RIS files into normalized citation rows with title, abstract, authors, DOI, PMID, URL, notes, and source-role information when present.
Support labeled file roles for `all`, `irrelevant`, `full_text`, `excluded`, and `included` in RIS packages.
RIS parsing produces the same downstream row contract used by the CSV parser so later merge logic is format-agnostic.

userStories.title: Merge labeled Covidence files into normalized article candidates
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want rows from multiple Covidence files merged by a stable article key so one canonical article record can carry screening-stage overlays and warnings.
acceptanceCriteria: Merge labeled rows with stable key priority `DOI -> PMID -> Covidence/reference id -> normalized title+year+first-author hash`.
Use the `all` file as the canonical metadata source while stage files overlay membership, tags, notes, and exclusion reasons.
The merge result reports conflicting stage memberships and missing matches for analysis instead of hiding them.

userStories.title: Add Covidence analyze route for multi-file packages
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to analyze a Covidence package before importing so I can confirm file roles, row coverage, and merge warnings before creating a datasource.
acceptanceCriteria: The analyze response returns mode, detected file roles, counts, warnings, and sample merged rows without persisting a datasource.
Analyze rejects invalid mode/file-role combinations such as missing required files or mutually exclusive membership conflicts that make the package unusable.

userStories.title: Persist merged Covidence packages as datasource article imports
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want Covidence package create and reimport to persist normalized articles on a stable import route so the datasource always reflects the merged package state.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `POST /api/datasources/import/covidence-create` and `POST /api/datasources/import/covidence` using import routes shaped as `covidence:<datasourceId>`.
Create stores all merged package articles as `ArticleImportStoreRow` values while preserving raw package metadata in `originalData` and `sourceMetadata`.
Reimport reloads the saved package config and updates the existing datasource/import route idempotently instead of creating duplicates.

userStories.title: Reuse or create Covidence prompts from screening criteria
userStories.description: As an admin, I want the import flow to reuse or create the right screening prompt from inclusion and exclusion criteria so each Covidence project starts with the expected judgment question.
acceptanceCriteria: Build prompt text for `title_abstract` and `full_text` modes with the stage-specific question, allowed answers, and `Inclusion:` / `Exclusion:` blocks.
Set prompt type to `'yes' | 'no'` or `'yes' | 'no' | 'unsure'` from the selected answer set.
Reuse an existing prompt when content, heading, and type already match; only create a new prompt when no existing prompt matches.

userStories.title: Create or reuse title/abstract projects linked to Covidence routes
userStories.description: As an admin, I want a `title_abstract` import to create or reuse a project linked to the Covidence import route so the screening package is immediately ready for review.
acceptanceCriteria: A `title_abstract` import creates or reuses one project for the datasource instead of leaving project setup to a manual follow-up step.
The project links to the Covidence import route and attaches the reused or created screening prompt.
The created project defaults to title and abstract review settings that match the screening stage input collected in the import flow.

userStories.title: Seed title/abstract human judgments from Covidence decisions
userStories.description: As an admin, I want `title_abstract` imports to seed human judgments from Covidence outcomes so irrelevant and full-text decisions appear immediately in the project.
acceptanceCriteria: Seed answered `judgment_human` rows for the created or reused title/abstract project using `irrelevant -> no` and `full_text -> yes`.
Rows without a Covidence decision remain unanswered so human or LLM review can still assess them later.
Reimport updates or preserves the same seeded human judgments idempotently instead of duplicating answers for the same project/article/prompt combination.

userStories.title: Create or reuse full-text projects with the correct article scope
userStories.description: As an admin, I want a `full_text` import to create or reuse a project scoped to the full-text stage so final screening starts from the right article set.
acceptanceCriteria: A `full_text` import creates or reuses one project for the datasource and links the selected prompt plus the Covidence import route.
The project scope defaults to articles that reached full-text review: `full_text ∪ excluded ∪ included`.
The project reuses the existing datasource/package state on reimport instead of creating a second project for the same Covidence package.

userStories.title: Seed full-text human judgments from included and excluded exports
userStories.description: As an admin, I want `full_text` imports to seed included and excluded decisions so final-screening projects start with the existing Covidence outcomes already recorded.
acceptanceCriteria: Seed answered `judgment_human` rows for the created or reused full-text project using `excluded -> no` and `included -> yes`.
If the prompt allows `unsure`, the import still seeds only `yes` and `no` answers from Covidence and leaves all other rows unanswered.
Reimport updates or preserves the same seeded full-text judgments idempotently for the same project/article/prompt combination.

userStories.title: Expose Covidence datasource metadata and linked entities through APIs
userStories.description: As an admin, I want datasource APIs to expose Covidence package details plus linked project and prompt information so the UI can render immutable imports and reimport controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Datasource list and detail responses expose Covidence package config together with linked project and linked prompt identifiers needed by the admin UI.
Covidence-backed datasources are marked immutable in the same way as other imported-file datasources except for archive and reimport actions.
API responses expose enough state for the UI to distinguish `title_abstract` and `full_text` imports without re-parsing cursor JSON on the client.

userStories.title: Build the admin Covidence multi-file import page
userStories.description: As an admin, I want a dedicated Covidence import page so I can choose a mode, upload the required files, preview merge results, and submit criteria-driven project creation in one flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `src/app/routes/+admin/+datasources/+covidence-import.tsx` with mode selection, multi-file upload, analyze preview, criteria fields, answer-set selection, project name, and model selection.
The page calls the analyze and create endpoints and shows validation or merge warnings before import.
Submitting the form creates the datasource/project flow for the chosen mode and navigates to the imported datasource or linked project context.

Browser verification: import 1 `title_abstract` package and 1 `full_text` package; datasource exists; project exists; prompt reused or created correctly; seeded human judgments match Covidence decisions; reimport does not duplicate prompt or project.

userStories.title: Wire Covidence datasource list, edit, and reimport UI affordances
userStories.description: As an admin, I want Covidence datasources to appear with the right entry points and immutable state so imported screening packages can be revisited and reimported safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a Covidence import CTA from the datasource list and a reimport action for Covidence-backed datasources.
The datasource edit view shows Covidence package mode, linked project, linked prompt, and immutable imported-source messaging.
UI affordances use API-provided Covidence metadata instead of re-deriving state from route strings or raw cursor parsing.

Browser verification: import 1 `title_abstract` package and 1 `full_text` package; datasource exists; project exists; prompt reused or created correctly; seeded human judgments match Covidence decisions; reimport does not duplicate prompt or project.
